title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

Nvidia cuts its fiscal-2028 growth outlook on February 24

The downturn market's triggers need Nvidia 50% below its record. A world where that has happened by May is one where demand, financing or export limits have visibly cut into orders, and about half of such worlds would show it as a lowered outlook at the February 24 report; the rest break later in the spring.
